Requirement: System shall validate ICD-10 codes in real time at point of entry in EHR
System shall prevent claim submission if ICD-10 code is invalid or missing
EHR shall auto-generate structured claim data on consultation completion
Claim data shall flow automatically to RCM system without manual re-entry
System shall verify pre-authorisation status before inpatient claim processing
Claims without valid pre-auth shall be flagged and held — not denied post-review
P3 predictive model shall run daily and flag members with high-cost probability >0.7
Flagged members shall be automatically referred to care management within 24 hours
System shall validate all claims against DHA/DoH rules before submission
Denied claims shall be automatically routed by denial reason with 90-day tracker
